headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Impeached Amid Banking Scandal
summary: Following the downfall of Ueno Bank, the Paraguayan Senate approved the dismissal of President Santiago Peña for alleged poor performance. Pedro Alliana assumed the presidency, while preventive detention was ordered for Peña.
why: Political instability and systemic banking crises in emerging markets can trigger sharp currency devaluations and alter investor confidence in sovereign debt.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political and banking turmoil directly impacts the sovereign risk profile of Paraguay.
